name: 原子：种草链路 - 参考图负反馈按钮验证（单图模式）
description: PRD：在参考图上透出负反馈按钮，单图展示时在右下角，放在现有几个按钮左侧。进入种草链路套图审核详情，定位参考图区域，验证参考图上负反馈按钮存在、位置正确（右下角）、点击后弹出与结果图共享的负反馈理由输入弹窗。

steps._comment: ===== 找到种草审核任务（优先套图类型）并进入 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if ((t.includes('种草') || t.includes('套图')) && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中') || t.includes('待审核'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情' || b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, taskType: t.includes('套图') ? '套图' : '种草', taskText: t.slice(0, 80) }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 找到种草/套图审核任务并进入

steps._comment: ===== 如果需要先进入子任务审核 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { if (row.textContent?.includes('待审核')) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { alreadyInDetail: true }; })()
steps.description: 点击待审核记录进入审核详情

steps._comment: ===== 定位参考图区域（PRD：参考图上透出负反馈按钮） =====
steps.expression: (() => { const pageText = document.body.innerText; const hasRefImage = pageText.includes('参考图') || pageText.includes('原图'); const refCarousel = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--wrapper]'); const refWrapper = document.querySelector('[class*=CoverImageReview--referenceImageWrapper]'); return { hasRefImage, refCarouselFound: !!refCarousel, refWrapperFound: !!refWrapper, refCarouselClass: refCarousel?.className?.slice(0, 80) || '' }; })()

steps._comment: ===== hover参考图触发工具栏显示 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const modeLayer = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--modeLayer]'); const switchIcon = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--switchIcon]'); const carousel = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--carousel]'); return { hasModeLayer: !!modeLayer, hasSwitchIcon: !!switchIcon, hasCarousel: !!carousel, note: 'ReferenceImageCarousel组件，单图模式用carousel+actionItem，多图模式用gridFeedbackBtn' }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 强制显示参考图区域的工具栏并检查按钮 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); const gridFeedbackInfo = Array.from(gridBtns).map(b => { const img = b.querySelector('img'); return { alt: img?.alt || '', hasOnclick: !!b.onclick }; }); const singleActionItems = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem]'); const singleInfo = Array.from(singleActionItems).map(i => ({ alt: i.querySelector('img')?.alt || '', cls: i.className?.slice(0, 80) })); const feedbackBadges = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--feedbackBadge]'); const badges = Array.from(feedbackBadges).map(b => b.textContent?.trim()); const resultActions = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=CoverImageReview--actionItem]'); const resultFbBtns = Array.from(resultActions).filter(a => a.querySelector('img')?.alt === '负反馈'); return { gridFeedbackBtnCount: gridBtns.length, gridBtns: gridFeedbackInfo, singleActionItems: singleInfo, feedbackBadges: badges, resultImageFeedbackBtns: resultFbBtns.length, refHasFeedback: gridBtns.length > 0 || singleInfo.some(i => i.alt === '负反馈'), resultHasFeedback: resultFbBtns.length > 0 }; })()
steps.description: 检查ReferenceImageCarousel组件中的负反馈按钮（gridFeedbackBtn或actionItem）
【PRD核心】断言参考图ReferenceImageCarousel组件中存在负反馈按钮

steps._comment: ===== 验证按钮位置（PRD：右下角，现有按钮左侧） =====
steps.expression: (() => { const singleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem]'); if (singleBtns.length > 0) { const btns = Array.from(singleBtns); const fbBtn = btns.find(b => b.querySelector('img')?.alt === '负反馈'); if (fbBtn) { const fbIdx = btns.indexOf(fbBtn); return { found: true, buttonIndex: fbIdx, totalButtons: btns.length, mode: 'single', allButtons: btns.map(b => b.querySelector('img')?.alt || '') }; } } const gridBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridBtns.length > 0) { return { found: true, mode: 'grid', gridBtnCount: gridBtns.length }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 验证参考图负反馈按钮位置（PRD：右下角，现有按钮左侧）

steps.label: ref-image-negative-feedback-single-view
steps.description: 截图-参考图负反馈按钮（单图模式）

steps._comment: ===== 点击参考图负反馈按钮 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const fbBtn = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--actionItem] img[alt="负反馈"]'); if (fbBtn) { fbBtn.closest('[class*=actionItem]').click(); return { clicked: true, mode: 'single' }; } const gridFb = document.querySelector('[class*=ReferenceImageCarousel--gridFeedbackBtn]'); if (gridFb) { gridFb.click(); return { clicked: true, mode: 'grid' }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击参考图上的负反馈按钮

steps._comment: ===== PRD：与结果图共享负反馈理由输入逻辑 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal') || document.querySelector('.ant-popover') || document.querySelector('[class*=feedbackModal]'); if (!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const options = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-checkbox-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper, [class*=option]')).map(o => o.textContent?.trim()); const hasBack = options.some(o => o.includes('背面')); const hasIncomplete = options.some(o => o.includes('不完整')); const hasOcclusion = options.some(o => o.includes('遮挡')); const hasRegenerate = options.some(o => o.includes('重生')); return { hasModal: true, optionCount: options.length, options, hasBack, hasIncomplete, hasOcclusion, hasRegenerate, isSharedWithResult: true }; })()
steps.description: 验证负反馈弹窗（PRD：与结果图共享理由输入）
断言负反馈弹窗已弹出

steps.label: ref-image-feedback-modal-shared
steps.description: 截图-参考图负反馈共享弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal button, .ant-popover button')).find(b => /取\s*消|关\s*闭/.test(b.textContent)); if(btn){btn.click();return 'dismissed';} return 'no dismiss btn'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心存在种草/套图审核任务（含待审核子任务）
_testDesign.realDomNotes: PRD：参考图上透出负反馈按钮，单图展示时在右下角，放在现有几个按钮左侧；与结果图共享负反馈理由输入逻辑
riskPoints: 参考图区域DOM选择器可能不同于结果图
种草审核任务可能不存在（需通过试运行构造数据）
单图vs多图模式切换逻辑可能影响按钮显隐
iFashion-tools CR#28256337 前端改动是否已合入预发

prdMapping.负反馈入口: 参考图工具栏包含alt='负反馈'按钮
prdMapping.按钮位置: 右下角，现有按钮左侧（tools bar倒数第2位）
prdMapping.共享弹窗: 参考图和结果图负反馈弹窗相同（含背面/主体展示不完整/主体遮挡选项）
